CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spotify_scrobbles (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  played_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  track_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  track_uri TEXT,
  track_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  artists JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  album TEXT,
  duration_ms INT,
  progress_ms INT,
  device_name TEXT
);

WITH win AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM spotify_scrobbles
  WHERE played_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
),
summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_scrobbles, COUNT(DISTINCT track_id)::int AS unique_tracks FROM win
),
top_tracks AS (
  SELECT track_id, MAX(track_name) AS name, MAX(artists::text)::jsonb AS artists, COUNT(*)::int AS plays
  FROM win
  GROUP BY track_id
  ORDER BY plays DESC, MAX(played_at) DESC
  LIMIT $2::int
),
top_artists AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*)::int AS plays
  FROM win, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(artists) AS artist
  GROUP BY artist
  ORDER BY plays DESC
  LIMIT $2::int
),
recent AS (
  SELECT track_id, track_name AS name, artists, album, played_at
  FROM win
  ORDER BY played_at DESC
  LIMIT $2::int
)
SELECT
  (SELECT total_scrobbles FROM summary) AS total_scrobbles,
  (SELECT unique_tracks FROM summary) AS unique_tracks,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) FROM top_tracks t), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_tracks,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) FROM top_artists a), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_artists,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM recent r), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent;
